verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch's own docs site exposes an llms.txt for AI-consumable content and its 'Embed' feature lets you create a runnable mini-version of the API client embeddable in docs, which partially satisfies an interactive, runnable reference experience. However, a direct probe found no OpenAPI/swagger spec published (404 on all candidate paths), so there's no structured, spec-driven interactive API reference for AI agents to explore Hoppscotch's own API surface. Missing for 10: a published OpenAPI/interactive API reference for Hoppscotch's own API, independent confirmation of the embed feature's AI-agent usability, and evidence of runnable examples specifically tailored for AI consumption beyond llms.txt.
